definitions.explanation: The most common variety of cherry blossom tree in Japan (Prunus × yedoensis). Produces pale pink to white flowers and accounts for roughly 80% of cherry trees in Japan.

examples.japanese: {染井吉野|そめいよしの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{満開|まんかい}→満開：13319_mankai⟧だ。
examples.english: The Somei-Yoshino cherries are in full bloom.

examples.english: Cherry blossom forecasts are based on Somei-Yoshino trees.

examples.japanese: {染井吉野|そめいよしの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦{末期|まっき}→末期：13032_makki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{染井村|そめいむら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Somei-Yoshino is said to be a variety that originated in Somei village in Tokyo in the late Edo period.

notes:
NAME ORIGIN:
{染井|そめい} refers to {染井村|そめいむら}, a village in what is now {豊島区|としまく}{駒込|こまごめ}, ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧. {吉野|よしの} refers to {吉野山|よしのやま} in {奈良県|ならけん}, historically famous for cherry blossoms. The variety was bred by nurseries in {染井村|そめいむら} and named after both locations.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{染井吉野|そめいよしの} is the standard reference tree for Japan's ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦{開花|かいか}→開花：14525_kaika⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧ (cherry blossom forecast). When news reports say "the cherry blossoms have bloomed," they mean {染井吉野|そめいよしの} specifically. All trees of this variety are clones propagated by grafting, so they bloom almost simultaneously in any given area.

- {染井吉野|そめいよしの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧: Somei-Yoshino blooms
